code_changes: Added chapter-generic **formula-family normalization** in `markdown_structurer.py` after supplemental recovery and before final payload build.
Rule C (same-key anomaly repair): when one formula key contains both `n` and `(n+1)a`, relabel `n -> n a` if available.

Rule B (global suffix support): for bare-only and unreferenced labels, use modular global suffix evidence (mention/spatial score) to relabel to strongest suffix variant.
